segments.ja: 船体は港を離れ、島の岸が後ろになります。後ろになる場所で、戦いの音はまだ続いています。続いている岸を、乗っている者はもう話し合いの席とは呼びません。呼ばないまま、キヨミの船体は距離を稼ぎます。稼ぐ距離の先に、地鳴らしの列があります。ある列は、海のほうまで光を濁しています。濁した光を、オニャンコポンは操縦の席から見ます。見る席に、演説はありません。見る席に、港の名はもうありません。
segments.en: The hull leaves the port, and the island's shore becomes behind. At the place that becomes behind, the sound of the fight is still continuing. The people aboard no longer call the shore that is continuing a seat of talk. Without calling it that, Kiyomi's hull gains distance. Ahead of the distance it gains is the row of the earth's march. The row that is there clouds the light as far as the sea. Onyankopon looks at the clouded light from the seat of flying. There is no speech in the seat he looks from. The port's name is no longer in the seat he looks from.

segments.ja: マガトは、船体には乗っていません。いない理由は、追ってくる兵を岸で止める、です。止める方法の詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。しません。置くのは、彼が子供たちを先に出した、です。出したあと、岸の音は船体の影から切れます。切れた岸を、ライナーは一度だけ振り返ります。振り返る顔は、上官を置いてきた顔です。置いてきた矜持を、彼は今日は言葉にしません。置いてきた矜持は、空の上で初めて遺志に聞こえます。
segments.en: Magath is not aboard the hull. The reason he is not is to stop the soldiers who are chasing, on the shore. Today's story does not turn the detail of stopping into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that he sent the children ahead. After he sent them, the sound of the shore cuts off from the hull's shadow. Reiner looks back once at the shore that cut off. The face that looks back is a face that left its officer. He does not put the pride he left into words today. The pride he left sounds, above the sky, like a will.

segments.ja: ハンジは、船体の中で残った人数を数えます。数える名前は、夜の輪で席を立たなかった人々です。人々の中に、アニとミカサとジャンがいます。いる数が、港を出たときより少ないです。少ない理由は、岸に残した者と、乗れなかった者がいる、です。いる空白を、彼女は団長の権限では埋めません。埋めない代わりに、次に届く距離だけを確認します。確認する声は、短いです。
segments.en: Inside the hull, Hange counts the people who remained. The names she counts are the people who did not leave their seats in the night circle. Among the people are Annie, Mikasa, and Jean. The number that is there is smaller than when they left the port. The reason it is smaller is that there are people left on the shore, and people who could not board. She does not fill the blank that is there with a commander's authority. In place of not filling it, she checks only the distance that can still be reached. The voice that checks is short.

segments.ja: ファルコは、人の形だけでは岸と船体のあいだを渡せません。渡せない距離を、新しい姿が翼のように結びます。結ぶ詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。しません。置くのは、ガビと、乗り遅れた者がその姿で運ばれた、です。運ばれたあと、ファルコは少年の顔に戻る余力をまだ持っています。持っている余力を、ガビが袖の位置で支えます。支える手が、飛行のあいだも離れません。支える手は、翼のあとでも少年の額を探しません。
segments.en: In a person's form alone, Falco cannot cross between the shore and the hull. A new form ties the distance he cannot cross, like wings. Today's story does not turn the detail of tying into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that Gabi, and those who were late to board, were carried by that form. After they were carried, Falco still has enough left to return to a boy's face. Gabi supports the leftover strength at the place of the sleeve. The hand that supports does not let go even during the flight. The supporting hand does not search for a boy's forehead even after the wings.

segments.ja: フロックは、港の名を船体の上まで運んできます。運んでくる名は、裏切り者です。裏切り者を、彼は飛ぶ影の中でも配ろうとします。配ろうとする体は、すでに岸の戦いをくぐってきています。くぐってきた一発が、船体の床に倒れます。倒れる結果を、今日の話は手順にしません。しません。置くのは、配りかけた名が、床の上で途切れる、です。途切れたあと、ジャンは銃を下ろしたまま息を見ます。
segments.en: Floch carries the port's name as far as the top of the hull. The name he carries is traitor. He tries to distribute traitor even inside the flying shadow. The body that tries has already come through the fight on the shore. A shot that came through that drops onto the hull's floor. Today's story does not turn the result of dropping into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that the name he was about to distribute breaks off on the floor. After it breaks off, Jean looks at the breath while the gun stays lowered.

tokens.note: Floch Forster, a recruit who survives the charge at Shiganshina.

segments.ja: アニは、結晶の外で初めて島を上から見ます。見る島は、自分が踏んだ街と、眠っていた年月を同時に持っています。持っている景色を、彼女は懐旧とは呼びません。呼ばない理由は、懐かしいと言えるほど綺麗ではない、です。ではない岸に、ヒッチの姿はもうありません。ないまま、彼女はミカサの隣で同じ方向を見ます。見る方向は、後ろの港ではなく、前の列です。前の列は、綺麗な回想より白いです。
segments.en: Outside the crystal, Annie looks down at the island for the first time. The island she looks at holds both the town she trampled and the years she slept. She does not call the scene she holds nostalgia. The reason she does not call it that is that it is not clean enough to call dear. Hitch's form is no longer on the shore that is not clean. Without it there, she looks in the same direction beside Mikasa. The direction they look is not the port behind. It is the row ahead. The row ahead is whiter than a clean recollection.

segments.ja: ミカサは、船体の窓から行進の濁りを見ます。見る濁りの中心に、エレンがいます。いる相手を、彼女はまだ標的の語では呼びません。呼ばない顔で、距離が縮むことを確認します。確認は、殺すの同意ではありません。ではありません。夜に残した矛盾が、空の上でも同じ人の中にあります。ある矛盾を、ジャンは隣で責めません。責めない理由は、自分の膝の銃も同じ矛盾だ、です。同じ矛盾が、空の床でも二人の膝にあります。
segments.en: From the hull's window, Mikasa looks at the cloud of the march. Eren is at the center of the cloud she looks at. She still does not call the person who is there by the word target. With the face that does not call him that, she checks that the distance is shrinking. The check is not agreement to kill. It is not. The contradiction left in the night is in the same person, even above the sky. Jean does not blame the contradiction that is there, beside her. The reason he does not blame it is that the gun on his own knee is the same contradiction. The same contradiction is on both knees, even on the floor of the sky.

segments.ja: ピークは、車力の速さを船体の中では使いません。使わない代わりに、届くまでの時間を数えます。数える隣で、ライナーはマガトの岸を一度だけ話します。話す内容は、子供を先に出せと言った、です。言った上官が、もう応答しないことを、二人は理解しています。理解したあとでも、彼らは名前を英雄にはしません。しない影の中で、ガビがファルコの額を見ています。見ている額は、まだ熱を持っています。
segments.en: Inside the hull, Pieck does not use the Cart's speed. In place of not using it, she counts the time until they arrive. Beside the counting, Reiner speaks of Magath's shore only once. The content he speaks is that the officer said to send the children ahead. The two understand that the officer who said it no longer answers. Even after they understand, they do not make the name into a hero. Inside the shadow that does not, Gabi is looking at Falco's forehead. The forehead she is looking at still holds heat.

segments.ja: 前を見ると、海が列で埋まっています。埋まっている光は、島の塵より白いです。白い列の幅を、ハンジは窓の枠では測り切れません。測り切れない幅が、夜に話した数の実物です。実物を見たガビは、自分の一発を再び思い出します。思い出す手は、もう銃を持っていません。持っていない手で、彼女はファルコの袖を握ります。握る理由は、この幅を一人で見ないためです。握る袖が、幅を二人の景色にします。
segments.en: Looking ahead, the sea is filled with the row. The light that fills it is whiter than the island's dust. Hange cannot fully measure the width of the white row by the frame of the window. The width she cannot fully measure is the real thing of the count they talked about in the night. Gabi, who saw the real thing, remembers her own shot again. The hand that remembers no longer holds a gun. With the hand that does not hold one, she grips Falco's sleeve. The reason she grips it is so she does not look at this width alone. The sleeve she grips makes the width into a scene for two.

segments.titleEn: Behind is no longer the island
segments.ja: しばらく飛ぶと、後ろは港ではなく雲です。雲の下に、マガトの岸と、ヒッチの道と、サシャの皿があります。あるものを、船体はもう拾えません。拾えない懐旧が、この話の題です。題の前で、ライナーは子供たちの肩を見ます。見る肩は、先に出せと言われた肩です。言われた言葉が、空の上で初めて命令ではなく遺志に聞こえます。遺志の言葉が、子供の肩に残ります。
segments.en: After flying a while, behind them is cloud, not the port. Under the cloud are Magath's shore, Hitch's road, and Sasha's plate. The hull can no longer pick up what is there. The looking back that cannot pick it up is the title of this story. In front of the title, Reiner looks at the children's shoulders. The shoulders he looks at are the shoulders that were told to go ahead. The words that were said sound, for the first time above the sky, like a will and not an order. The words of that will remain on the children's shoulders.

segments.en: When the looking back pauses, only ahead remains on the hull. Ahead, the contact of Eren and Zeke is making the row walk. It is not yet known whether a conversation can reach the person making it walk. While it stays unknown, Hange checks the next height. There is no smile on the face that checks. Beside the smile that is not there, Annie opens her fist for the first time. The fist she opens is less a preparation for a fight than the end of a long sleep.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。懐旧は、船体が港を後ろにしたあとの見方です。マガトは岸に残り、子供たちを先に出します。ハンジは、乗った人数を数えます。ファルコの新しい姿が、遅れた者を運びます。フロックの名は、船体の床で途切れます。アニは、島を上から見て綺麗だとは言いません。ミカサは、標的の語を受けないまま前を見ます。キヨミは、もう港へ戻れないと言います。前には、海を埋める列があります。埋める列を、懐旧は綺麗にはしません。
segments.en: Today's words. Looking back is the view after the hull has put the port behind. Magath remains on the shore and sends the children ahead. Hange counts the people who boarded. Falco's new form carries those who were late. Floch's name breaks off on the hull's floor. Annie looks down at the island and does not call it clean. Mikasa looks ahead without receiving the word target. Kiyomi says they can no longer return to the port. Ahead, there is a row filling the sea. Looking back does not make the filling row clean.

vocab.exampleEn: Inside the hull, Hange counts the people who remained. The names she counts are the people who did not leave their seats in the night circle. In place of not filling it, she checks only the distance that can still be reached. The voice that checks is short.

It does not. What it sets down is that he sent the children ahead. After he sent them, the sound of the shore cuts off from the hull's shadow. Reiner looks back once at the shore that cut off. vocab.exampleEn: The hull leaves the port, and the island's shore becomes behind. At the place that becomes behind, the sound of the fight is still continuing. The people aboard no longer call the shore that is continuing a seat of talk. Without calling it that, Kiyomi's hull gains distance. Ahead of the distance it gains is the row of the earth's march. The row that is there clouds the light as far as the sea. Onyankopon looks at the clouded light from the seat of flying. There is no speech in the seat he looks from. The port's name is no longer in the seat he looks from.

vocab.exampleJa: ではない岸に、ヒッチの姿はもうありません。
vocab.exampleEn: Outside the crystal, Annie looks down at the island for the first time. The island she looks at holds both the town she trampled and the years she slept. She does not call the scene she holds nostalgia. The reason she does not call it that is that it is not clean enough to call dear. Hitch's form is no longer on the shore that is not clean. Without it there, she looks in the same direction beside Mikasa. The direction they look is not the port behind. It is the row ahead. The row ahead is whiter than a clean recollection.

The body that tries has already come through the fight on the shore. A shot that came through that drops onto the hull's floor. Today's story does not turn the result of dropping into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that the name he was about to distribute breaks off on the floor. After it breaks off, Jean looks at the breath while the gun stays lowered.

vocab.note: The hull is in the air. How it is flown stays off the page. What matters is who is aboard and who is not.
vocab.exampleJa: 支える手が、飛行のあいだも離れません。
vocab.exampleEn: In a person's form alone, Falco cannot cross between the shore and the hull. A new form ties the distance he cannot cross, like wings. Today's story does not turn the detail of tying into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that Gabi, and those who were late to board, were carried by that form. After they were carried, Falco still has enough left to return to a boy's face. Gabi supports the leftover strength at the place of the sleeve. The hand that supports does not let go even during the flight. The supporting hand does not search for a boy's forehead even after the wings.

vocab.exampleJa: 責めない理由は、自分の膝の銃も同じ矛盾だ、です。
vocab.exampleEn: From the hull's window, Mikasa looks at the cloud of the march. Eren is at the center of the cloud she looks at. She still does not call the person who is there by the word target. With the face that does not call him that, she checks that the distance is shrinking. The check is not agreement to kill. It is not. The contradiction left in the night is in the same person, even above the sky. Jean does not blame the contradiction that is there, beside her. The reason he does not blame it is that the gun on his own knee is the same contradiction. The same contradiction is on both knees, even on the floor of the sky.

vocab.exampleJa: 歩かせている相手へ、会話が届くかどうかはまだ不明です。
vocab.exampleEn: When the looking back pauses, only ahead remains on the hull. Ahead, the contact of Eren and Zeke is making the row walk. It is not yet known whether a conversation can reach the person making it walk. While it stays unknown, Hange checks the next height. There is no smile on the face that checks. Beside the smile that is not there, Annie opens her fist for the first time. The fist she opens is less a preparation for a fight than the end of a long sleep.

vocab.exampleJa: 置いてきた矜持は、空の上で初めて遺志に聞こえます。
vocab.exampleEn: Magath is not aboard the hull. The reason he is not is to stop the soldiers who are chasing, on the shore. Today's story does not turn the detail of stopping into a procedure. It does not. What it sets down is that he sent the children ahead. After he sent them, the sound of the shore cuts off from the hull's shadow. Reiner looks back once at the shore that cut off. The face that looks back is a face that left its officer. He does not put the pride he left into words today. The pride he left sounds, above the sky, like a will.

vocab.exampleJa: ジャンは、船体の床に途切れた名を片づけます。
vocab.exampleEn: Jean clears the name that broke off on the hull's floor. The name he clears is traitor, which Floch was about to distribute. He does not yet fully admit that traitor means themselves. Without fully admitting it, he quiets the floor. After he quiets it, he nods shortly to Mikasa. The nod does not mean they shared the word target. It does not. It means they look ahead while keeping the same contradiction.

vocab.exampleEn: Outside the crystal, Annie looks down at the island for the first time. The island she looks at holds both the town she trampled and the years she slept. Without it there, she looks in the same direction beside Mikasa. The direction they look is not the port behind. It is the row ahead. The row ahead is whiter than a clean recollection.

vocab.exampleJa: 前を見ると、海が列で埋まっています。
vocab.exampleEn: Looking ahead, the sea is filled with the row. The light that fills it is whiter than the island's dust. Hange cannot fully measure the width of the white row by the frame of the window. The width she cannot fully measure is the real thing of the count they talked about in the night. Gabi, who saw the real thing, remembers her own shot again. The hand that remembers no longer holds a gun. With the hand that does not hold one, she grips Falco's sleeve. The reason she grips it is so she does not look at this width alone. The sleeve she grips makes the width into a scene for two.

vocab.exampleJa: 数える名前は、夜の輪で席を立たなかった人々です。
vocab.exampleEn: Inside the hull, Hange counts the people who remained. The names she counts are the people who did not leave their seats in the night circle. Among the people are Annie, Mikasa, and Jean. The number that is there is smaller than when they left the port. The reason it is smaller is that there are people left on the shore, and people who could not board. She does not fill the blank that is there with a commander's authority. In place of not filling it, she checks only the distance that can still be reached. The voice that checks is short.
